enabled.description: "Always" call forwarding is enabled or disabled.

ringReminderEnabled.description: If `true`, a brief tone will be played on the virtual line's phone when a call has been forwarded.

destinationVoicemailEnabled.description: Indicates enabled or disabled state of sending incoming calls to voicemail when the destination is an internal phone number and that number has the voicemail service enabled.

always.description: Settings for forwarding all incoming calls to the destination you choose.

enabled.description: "Busy" call forwarding is enabled or disabled.

destinationVoicemailEnabled.description: Indicates the enabled or disabled state of sending incoming calls to voicemail when the destination is an internal phone number and that number has the voicemail service enabled.

busy.description: Settings for forwarding all incoming calls to the destination you chose while the phone is in use or the virtual line is busy.

enabled.description: "No Answer" call forwarding is enabled or disabled.

numberOfRings.description: Number of rings before the call will be forwarded if unanswered.

systemMaxNumberOfRings.description: System-wide maximum number of rings allowed for `numberOfRings` setting.

destinationVoicemailEnabled.description: Indicates the enabled or disabled state of sending incoming calls to destination number's voicemail if the destination is an internal phone number and that number has the voicemail service enabled.

noAnswer.description: Settings for forwarding which only occurs when you are away or not answering your phone.

callForwarding.description: Settings related to "Always", "Busy", and "No Answer" call forwarding.

enabled.description: Business Continuity is enabled or disabled.

destinationVoicemailEnabled.description: Indicates enabled or disabled state of sending incoming calls to the destination number's voicemail if the destination is an internal phone number and that number has the voicemail service enabled.

businessContinuity.description: Settings for sending calls to a destination of your choice if your phone is not connected to the network for any reason, such as power outage, failed Internet connection, or wiring problem.
